title: Loop-call configuration
statement: Given Boolean finite Turing machines $B$ and $F$, a state $a$ of $B$, an input word $x$, a Boolean $s$, a configuration $c$ of $B$ on $x$, a Boolean $r$, an optional Boolean $f$, a Boolean word $w$, and a configuration $g$ of $F$ on $x$, the construction returns a configuration on $x$ with $B.k+F.k+3$ work tapes and state set $F.State\oplus((\{0,1\}\times(B.State\times\{0,1\}))\oplus\{0,1,\ldots,13\})$. Its state is encoded from $s$ and the state of the padded loop-body configuration; the additional tag is $6$ if $s$ is true and $7$ otherwise.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the capture operation or padded loop-body configuration, so the construction's full tape contents, head positions, and state behavior cannot be stated.
